name: arkadaz
description: Harness engineering and code quality skills for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: tiger-skills
plugins.description: Harness engineering + code quality skills. 14 skills, 6 agents, 1 command, and a deterministic linear single-feature workflow: grill (merged markdown feature.md + broad Robot e2e, cuts feature/<id> from dev) → architect (plan + tiger/CODEBASE_MAP.md) → generators (parallel git worktrees, TDD + simplify + no comments) → e2e (single gate: run for real, add cases, triage by priority) → update-docs (refresh markdown docs, fast-forward merge to dev; main protected, dev→main manual). tiger-security / tiger-reviewer are standalone on-demand gates. Skills are independent units; agents bundle skills.
